sentences.text:
Raja Chakraverty vs The State Of West Bengal And Another on 6
June, 2023

Author: Tirthankar Ghosh
Bench: Tirthankar Ghosh
June 6, 2023 Ad - 29 Ct. 34 Sg Crr 1926 of 2023 Raja Chakraverty
-versus-
The State of West Bengal and another Mr. S.D. Mahapatra Mr. Agniswar Chowdhury ... for the
petitioner Mr. Anwar Hossain Ms. Ratna Ghosh ... for the State.

The petitioner has challenged the proceedings arising out of Khardah Police Station Case No.285 of
2022 dated 17.04.2022.
The petitioner is directed to serve a copy upon Ms. Ratna Ghosh, learned advocate who ordinarily appears on behalf of the State, and is directed to represent the State.
Her appearance may be regularised by the concerned authorities.
The investigation in this case commenced on 17.04.2022.

Mr. Mahapatra, learned advocate for the petitioner submits that the ingredients of Section 498A of IPC are lacking in the letter of complaint which has been treated as the FIR of the instant case and in spite of same the police authorities registered the case.
The investigation is continuing for more than a year, this Court restrains from commenting on the contents of the letter of complaint.
The investigating authority would assess in all fairness whether a case under Section 498A of IPC is made out while submitting their report under Section 173 Cr.P.C.
The petitioner would be at liberty at a subsequent stage to approach this court in case the report under Section 173 Cr.P.C. implicates him.
With the aforesaid observations, CRR 1926 of 2023 is disposed of.
Pending application, if any, is consequently disposed of.
All parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.
